Check: 308,129 + 154,156 = 462,285 (p5 total revenues).

gaps.explanation: detail[] business-type lines come from the p11 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Budgetary Basis (actual): Sanitation 41,548 + Wastewater 78,600 + Water 54,589 + debt service principal 44,433 + interest 26,876 = 246,046. The p8 proprietary statement prints total operating expenditures 306,697 + interest expenditure 26,876 = 333,573, which includes depreciation 130,517 and excludes loan principal 44,433. Per fund: Sewer 147,780 - 69,180 depreciation = 78,600 (equal); Sanitation 41,548 (equal); Water 117,369 - 61,337 = 56,032 vs budget 54,589 (budget 1,443 lower). 130,517 - 44,433 + 1,443 = 87,527 = gap. Two printed totals on different bases; no fix.
